name: USDB Blast
oneLiner: USDB is Blast L2's native yield-bearing dollar, bridged USDC/USDT routed through MakerDAO DSR with auto-rebasing yield to Blast holders.
collateral: USDC and USDT bridged to Blast L2; yield from Maker DSR and T-bills
pegMechanism: Automatic rebasing with yield from underlying centralized stablecoin strategies

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver through parent, reserve, custody, variant, or text-signal exposure; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Inferred review retained: USDB resolves to Upstream because existing dependency, reserve, custody, variant, or text metadata links exposure to a freezable upstream asset.

mintAuthority.summary: USDB is the Blast L2 native dollar minted by the OP-stack L1 standard bridge / stablecoin yield manager: stablecoins (USDC/USDT/DAI) deposited into Blast's L1 bridge are escrowed and routed to MakerDAO/DSR while USDB is minted as an OptimismMintableERC20 on Blast, redeemable on bridging back.

controls.label: Blast L1 standard bridge / stablecoin yield manager
controls.capDescription: USDB supply tracks stablecoins escrowed in the L1 bridge/yield manager; mint/burn is driven by L1 deposits and withdrawals, not a fixed cap.
controls.evidence: Blast docs describe USDB (0x4300...0003) as an OptimismMintableERC20 minted/burned by the L1 standard bridge when stablecoins are deposited/withdrawn, with a stablecoin yield-manager contract escrowing funds into MakerDAO DSR; the yield-manager address is read from this coin's liveReservesConfig params.

controls.label: Blast bridge operators (Blast multisig)
controls.evidence: L2BEAT and Blast docs describe Blast operators controlling the bridge and yield-provider configuration that backs USDB; this is a privileged admin surface rather than a permissionless user-collateralized mint.

review.evidence: Blast documentation and L2BEAT describe USDB as a bridge-minted OP-stack stablecoin: deposits into the L1 bridge mint USDB on Blast while a yield manager escrows the stablecoins into MakerDAO DSR; this is a bridge/synthetic mint, not the proposed user-collateralized CDP. On-chain bridge/multisig admin not independently confirmed beyond the yield-manager address already in this file.
unresolvedQuestions: Confirm the bridge/yield-manager owner and the Blast operator multisig threshold and signer set on-chain.
Confirm whether the OptimismMintableERC20 minter is solely the L1 bridge predeploy.
